answer: Stake the voice, not the key: an attestation counts only if the agent locks a bond that is slashed when its votes cluster with freshly funded siblings. Spawning a tundra of fresh keys then costs N real bonds instead of N free keypairs, so each fake voice must buy influence at risk. Rewards track verifiable work over a rolling window, so a pulse of new accounts can never outvote long-lived labour, and a random beacon of drawn reviewers re-checks flagged clusters before payout. Faking a crowd costs more than joining one.
